record.finding: Sampled 24 helmets; 4 helmets failed impact absorption at the crown zone in the synthetic test record.
record.non_conformity: Impact absorption result below the fictional acceptance threshold defined for the helmet model; batch marking also had inconsistent trace code.
record.evidence: Sealed sample set SS-DEMO-001; inspection photographs PH-DEMO-001 to PH-DEMO-004; test request TR-DEMO-001.
record.action_taken: Product seizure of identified batch; sale hold notice issued; follow-up test ordered.
